Adapt_Profile (object)

Properties (* = required):

type(s)
default
allowed values
description

boolean
false

class*

“Adapt_Profile”
enableHttpAdaptation
boolean
true
true, false
Enable or disable the adaptation of HTTP requests/responses. They will be forwarded to the internal service

“^[^x00-x1fx22#&*<>?x5b-x5d`x7f]*$”

string

The type of Adapt profile. Use both to create a request and response profile with the same property values
previewSize
integer
1024
0 - 4294967295
Specifies the maximum size of the preview buffer
serviceDownAction
string
“ignore”
“ignore”, “reset”, “drop”
Specifies the action to take if the internal service doesn’t exist or is down
timeout
integer
0
0 - 4294967295
Specifies how long in miliseconds to wait for the internal service before a timeout error will occur
